verdict.rationale: Expensify's AI assistant offers instant answers and charts on account spend (expensify-docs-22). SmartScan extracts merchant, date and total in real time rather than in overnight batches (expensify-docs-18, expensify-docs-6), and expenses can be categorized and tagged (expensify-docs-3), which together suggest some same-day visibility. Corporate cards can be imported (expensify-docs-21), but nothing shows a live spend dashboard broken down by team, category and merchant. Community reports that categorization is often wrong (expensify-comm-1, expensify-comm-4) and that receipt processing can take around 20 minutes (expensify-comm-5) lower confidence in the category view and in timeliness. Missing for 10: a documented real-time spend dashboard, per-team/department breakdowns, merchant-level reporting views, evidence of same-day card transaction feeds, and independent hands-on corroboration.
